description: This file defines a Go package 'procfs' that models and parses wireless network statistics from /proc/net/wireless, including a Wireless struct and functions to read and parse wireless interface data.

classes.name: Wireless
classes.description: Represents wireless network interface statistics from /proc/net/wireless.

methods.name: Wireless
methods.description: Returns kernel wireless statistics for all wireless interfaces.

methods.name: parseWireless
methods.description: Parses the contents of /proc/net/wireless and returns a list of Wireless structs.
